evidence_head_policy.convention: qa_authority.source_head names the commit whose bytes were tested and it is an ancestor of the commit that records this packet (a commit reachable on main, verifiable with git merge-base --is-ancestor). The packet commit is evidence-only: it may modify only evidence/next/T19-CURRENT-MAIN-ACCEPTANCE.md, evidence/next/T19-RELEASE-ACCEPTANCE.json, the constants in test/t19-release-acceptance/t19-release-acceptance.test.mjs, and the release-control evidence files release/next/compatibility-inventory.json, release/next/release-plan.json and release/next/README.md (no test added or removed, so the T19 count stays 75).
evidence_head_policy.verification: git merge-base --is-ancestor <source_head> <packet_head> must succeed, and git diff --name-only <source_head>..<packet_head> must list only the six files above; the packet cannot name its own commit or its own CI run.
